description_en: Queries the domain names that have been deleted from your account
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDeletedDomains查询您名下已删除的域名
name: DescribeDcdnDeletedDomains

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The default value is 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码，默认值1，取值范围：1~100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of domain names to return on each page. The default value is 20. Valid values: an integer from 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的域名个数，默认值20，取值范围：1~500之前的任意整数
parameters.name: page_size

PageData.description_en: The information about the accelerated domain names

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the accelerated domain name was last modified. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
GmtModified.description_zh: 加速域名修改时间。日期格式按照ISO 8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

PageNumber.description_en: The number of the returned page. The value is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of domain names returned on each page. The value is the same as the PageSize request parameter
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的域名个数，同请求参数的PageSize

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of domain names that are returned
